SYMPTOM: History page shows very few or no items despite thousands of recordings on disk
CAUSE: Old buggy code wrote `created_at` as `2025-07-28T18T56:27.159284Z` (second T where : should be). parse_history_item used `.ok()?` on DateTime parse → silent skip. Affects Jul 2025–Jan 2026 recordings (1,534 total). Also: hundreds of recent recordings are aborted 44-byte WAV headers with no meta.json, polluting the index.
FIX:
  1. Startup migration rewrites bad timestamps on disk (marker file prevents re-run)
  2. parse_timestamp_from_folder_name now handles T-separated folder names (`2025-07-28T18-56-27-...`)
  3. parse_history_item now only requires non-empty transcript — everything else defaults (created_at falls back to folder name → file mtime → Unix epoch)
  4. Index excludes WAV files < 1024 bytes (header-only, no real audio)
  5. load_local_history_paginated: drops RwLock before I/O, accurate total_valid count, has_more = items.len() == limit && offset + limit < total_count
PREVENT: Future timestamp writes should use standard RFC3339 formatting; parse_history_item should never use `?` on optional fields
